title: Verify OrderItem Save Returns Detailed Error Message for Permission Error
description: Ensures that when a save operation fails due to permission error, the system returns a properly localized error message instead of generic error text.
preconditions: User is logged in with limited checklist permissions
A work request exists with checklist steps
User does not have permission to save checklist questions

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a work request checklist step page
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step page loads with questions visible

manual_steps.action: Modify a checklist question response and click Save
manual_steps.expected_result: Save operation fails and returns specific error message about permission error, not generic 'save error' message
manual_steps.notes: Error should be localized and specific to permission denial

title: Verify OrderItem Save Returns Success Response with QuestionsSuccess True
description: Ensures that when checklist step save operation succeeds, the response contains QuestionsSuccess: true in the response body as required for silent failure detection.
preconditions: User is logged in with checklist save permissions
A work request exists with checklist steps

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a work request checklist step page and modify a question response
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step page loads with editable questions

manual_steps.action: Click Save button and verify response body
manual_steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 response with QuestionsSuccess: true in response body. Changes are persisted.
manual_steps.notes: Must check response body - HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient due to silent failure pattern

title: Verify OrderItem Save Handles Missing Step Data Gracefully
description: Ensures that when checklist step save is called without valid step data, the system returns appropriate error response without causing server error.
preconditions: User is logged in with checklist permissions
User is on checklist step page

manual_steps.action: Submit checklist step save request without providing step data
manual_steps.expected_result: System returns validation error indicating missing step data
manual_steps.notes: Should not cause 500 error or application crash

manual_steps.action: Verify error message is displayed to user
manual_steps.expected_result: User sees appropriate error message, form remains functional
manual_steps.notes: Error should be user-friendly and actionable

title: Verify OrderItem View Loads Step Content Correctly
description: Ensures that checklist step view page loads properly with step details and questions when valid step ID is provided.
preconditions: User is logged in with checklist view permissions
A work request exists with at least one checklist step
Step ID is valid and accessible

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step view page with valid step ID
manual_steps.expected_result: Page loads successfully showing step details and questions

manual_steps.action: Verify all step information is displayed correctly
manual_steps.expected_result: Step title, questions, and current responses are visible and formatted properly
manual_steps.notes: Check that no null reference errors occur during page rendering

title: Verify OrderItem View Returns 404 for Invalid Step ID
description: Ensures that when an invalid or non-existent step ID is requested, the system returns appropriate 404 error rather than exposing system internals.
preconditions: User attempts to access non-existent step ID

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step view page with invalid step ID (e.g., 99999)
manual_steps.expected_result: System returns 404 Not Found error or appropriate error page

manual_steps.action: Verify no sensitive system information is exposed in error response
manual_steps.expected_result: Error page shows user-friendly message without exposing database details or stack traces

title: Verify OrderItem Permission Validation Before Save Operation
description: Ensures that checklist step save operation properly validates user permissions before attempting to save data, preventing unauthorized modifications.
preconditions: User is logged in but lacks CanSaveChecklist permission
A work request with checklist steps exists
User can view but cannot modify checklist data

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step page as user without save permissions
manual_steps.expected_result: Page loads with checklist visible but save functionality disabled or hidden

manual_steps.action: Attempt to save checklist step data via direct API call
manual_steps.expected_result: Request is rejected with 403 Forbidden or appropriate permission error before any data processing
manual_steps.notes: Security test - ensure server-side permission validation
